objectives.burst_5s: damage dealt to the dummy in the first 5 s
objectives.fight_15s: damage dealt to the dummy in the first 15 s
objectives.sustained_30s: damage dealt to the dummy in the first 30 s

dummy: never acts, no resists, refills instead of dying, HP = weighted median of real builds at the budget
aim: ranked median hero accuracy and headshot rate, real ability landing and melee rates
